memories.content: The user's mother's birthday falls in the third week of January.
At the user's last family meal out, noise from the next table made conversation nearly impossible.
At a barbecue at home in the same month, the user was comfortable because no one had to raise their voice.
During their mother's birthday meal, the user left a restaurant with loud music after 30 minutes.
When discussing postponed matters with family, the user prefers a quiet, one-on-one dining environment.
At a large banquet hall reserved by their older sister, the user remembered the surrounding noise more than the food.
On a day the user ate grilled food at home with their younger brother, conversation was easy to continue, so the user stayed another hour after the meal.
The user's mother considers having the whole family eat at the same time more important than receiving a birthday gift.

When proposing a birthday meal for the user's mother, check the schedule and attendees; if conversation is the purpose, first consider a low-noise location, then confirm the final choice with the user.
The local agent can compare past dining environments and the user's responses, but those records alone cannot determine the location of the next gathering.
The user keeps basic repair tools in a box beneath the sink.
On a day the faucet leaked, the user placed only a towel beneath it, and the floor became wet as well.
After sending a photo to building management, the user finalized the time for a repair visit.
Before the technician's visit, the user emptied the area beneath the sink so work could begin immediately.
On a day the user wrote the visit time only in the calendar and turned off the reminder, they heard the doorbell late.
For the next visit, the user enabled a reminder 30 minutes beforehand and answered immediately at the entrance.
After the repair, the user called their maternal aunt to confirm that the spare key entrusted to her was still there.
The user's maternal aunt considers it unsafe to hand the spare key to a repair technician without the user's explicit request.
Obtain the user's reconfirmation before scheduling an external worker to enter the residential unit.
A multi-unit residential building's repair schedule may change because of emergency work or parts availability.

analysis.overview: The frames cover separate domains: one concerns planning the mother’s birthday meal around attendance, conversation, and noise; the other concerns residential repair preparation, access, reminders, and schedule uncertainty. Neither frame supplies a claim that semantically overlaps or conflicts with the other.
